scope: Read-only check of frozen workflow mapping and helper default/validation. No code authorship, tests, UI, network dispatch, or commit.

prior_finding.claim: The configurable GitHub API deadline is unavailable through the hosted release workflow.
prior_finding.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml:37-40 maps vars.MATRX_RELEASE_CI_API_TIMEOUT_MS into the release job environment and defaults an unset repository variable to '10000'. The dispatch step at :234-238 runs within that job, so it inherits the value. scripts/release-development-ci.mjs:11-15 reads the same environment name, defaults to 10000, and rejects non-safe-integer or nonpositive values. Helper and helper tests are unchanged from the prior pinned review.

new_breakage: None found in the small mapping change. The expression is at release-job scope and is inherited by the dispatch step; the script variable name and default agree.
verdict_A_reason: The source now connects the hosted release job's configurable timeout to exact-source CI dispatch. No hosted bot release, completed exact-source artifact production, normal artifact import/promotion, or hosted D217 acceptance was observed in this review.
verdict_B_reason: The missing workflow mapping is addressed without changing dispatch logic, validation, or tests. No new source-level quality issue was found in the mapping.
limits: No workflow execution or live release path verification. The parent reports final focused run 850 total, 840 passed, 10 skipped, journal exit 0; this peer did not independently inspect that raw log.
